In this notebook, I will make plots for Supplemental Figure 8

# Setup

```{r setup}
library(Seurat)
library(scales)
library(tidyverse)
library(ggpmisc)

thisseed <- 231103

colFGID <- "#1E88E5"
coliCD <- "#55D276"
colcCD <- "#FFC107"
colUC <- "#D81B60"
diagSubColVec <- c("FGID"=colFGID, "iCD" = coliCD, "cCD"=colcCD, "UC"=colUC)

diagSub.comp <- list(c("FGID", "cCD"), c("iCD", "cCD"), c("cCD", "UC"), c("FGID", "UC"))

`%notin%` <- Negate(`%in%`)

source("../functions/ComparisonPlottingFxns.R")
```

## Seurat Object

```{r}
seuobj <- readRDS("data/objects/annotated/predictCOL__CB_allcells_annotated_251017_v4.rds")
seuobj
```

## IHC

```{r}
metadata <- readRDS("data/metadata/241120__predictCOL_metadata_COL_GEX.rds")
metadata
```

### TLS

```{r}
tls <- readRDS("out/ihc/panimmune/tls_long.rds")
tls
```

```{r}
tls.df.long <- tls %>% filter(!is.na(diagSub)) %>% 
  mutate(sample_id = paste(participant_id, colon_site_ihc, sep = "_")) %>% 
  relocate(sample_id) %>% 
  mutate(diagSub = fct_relevel(diagSub, c("FGID", "iCD", "cCD", "UC"))) %>% 
  filter(participant_id %in% metadata$participant_id) 

tls.df.long
```

### Panel 28

```{r}
p28 <- readRDS("out/ihc/panimmune/panel28_long.rds")
p28
```

```{r}
p28.df.wide <- p28 %>% filter(!is.na(diagSub)) %>% 
  mutate(sample_id = paste(participant_id, colon_site_ihc, area, sep = "_")) %>% 
  relocate(sample_id) %>% 
  mutate(diagSub = fct_relevel(diagSub, c("FGID", "iCD", "cCD", "UC"))) %>% 
  filter(participant_id %in% metadata$participant_id) %>% 
  filter(!is.na(area)) %>% 
  mutate(across(`CD20+`:`CD3+CD8-FOXP3-`, ~as.double(.)))

p28.df.wide

p28.df.long <- p28.df.wide %>% 
  pivot_longer(`CD20+`:`CD3+CD8-FOXP3-`, names_to = "marker", values_to = "density") 

p28.df.long
```

# TLS-like B Cells

```{r, fig.width=5, fig.height=4.5}
SenderReceiver(
  seuobj@meta.data %>% filter(timepoint == "T0"),
  senderCol = "cellstate",
  senderVal = c("GC-like BC"),
  senderProp = TRUE,
  senderRelative = "celltype",
  receiverCol = "cellstate",
  receiverVal = c("Prlf. BC"),
  receiverProp = TRUE,
  receiverRelative = "celltype",
  minSenderFreq = 10,
  minReceiverFreq = 10,
  r2level = 0.999, 
  ncols = 10,
  swap_facets = T,
  doTests = F,
  exportSampleDF = T
) %>% 
  ggplot(aes(x = prop.sender, y = prop.receiver)) +
  geom_point(shape = 21, aes(fill = diagSub), size = 4) +
  stat_poly_line(method = "lm") +
  stat_poly_eq(method = "lm", use_label(c("R2","P")), size=6) + 
  scale_fill_manual(values = diagSubColVec) +
  scale_x_continuous(labels = percent, breaks = pretty_breaks()) +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = percent, breaks = pretty_breaks()) +
  labs(
    x = "GC-like BC Frequency\n(Relative to B Cells)", 
    y = "Prlf. BC Frequency\n(Relative to B Cells)", 
    fill = NULL
  ) +
  theme_light() +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(size = 18, face = "bold"),
    plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 14, face = "bold"),
    axis.text.x = element_text(size = 16, face = "bold"),
    axis.text.y = element_text(size = 16, face = "bold"),
    axis.title.x = element_text(size = 16, face = "bold"),
    axis.title.y = element_text(size = 16, face = "bold"),
    legend.position = "top",
    legend.text = element_text(size = 16, face = "bold"),
    legend.title = element_text(size = 16, face = "bold"),
    strip.text = element_text(size = 16, face = "bold", color = "black"),
    strip.background = element_rect(fill = "white", colour = "black", linewidth = 1),
    panel.spacing.x = unit(0.25, "cm")
  )
```

```{r, fig.width=3.5, fig.height=4}
PlotBoxplotsProp(
  seuobj@meta.data %>% filter(timepoint == "T0") %>% 
    mutate(cellstate.b = ifelse(cellstate %in% c("GC-like BC", "Prlf. BC"), "TLS-like BC", as.character(cellstate))) %>% 
    mutate(cellstate.b = as.factor(cellstate.b)) %>% 
    droplevels,  
  ann.col = "cellstate.b",
  filterCol = "cellstate.b",
  filterVal = c("TLS-like BC"),
  relative.to = "celltype",
  minDenomFreq = 10,
  exportDF = T
) %>%
  mutate(facetName = "TLS-like B Cell") %>% 
  ggplot(aes(x = diagSub, y = prop)) +
  geom_boxplot(outlier.shape = NA, fill = NA) +
  geom_point(aes(fill = diagSub), size = 5,
             shape = 21, alpha = 0.75, position = position_jitterdodge(jitter.width = 0.75, seed = thisseed)) +
  facet_grid(~facetName) +
  scale_size_continuous(range = c(2, 7)) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = diagSubColVec) +
  scale_color_manual(values = diagSubColVec) +
  stat_compare_means(comparisons = diagSub.comp, label = "p.format", vjust = 1.5, size = 5) + 
  scale_y_continuous(labels = percent) +
  guides(fill = "none") +
  labs(
    y = "GC-like BC + Prlf. BC\n(Relative to B Cells)", 
    ) +
  theme_light() +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(size = 18, face = "bold"),
    plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 14, face = "bold"),
    axis.text.x = element_text(size = 16, face = "bold", angle = 0, hjust=0.5),
    axis.text.y = element_text(size = 16, face = "bold"),
    axis.title.x = element_blank(),
    axis.title.y = element_text(size = 16, face = "bold"),
    legend.position = "bottom",
    legend.text = element_text(size = 12, face = "bold"),
    legend.title = element_text(size = 12, face = "bold"),
    strip.text = element_text(size = 20, face = "bold", color = "black"),
    strip.background = element_rect(fill = "white", colour = "black", linewidth = 1),
  ) + guides(size = guide_legend(nrow = 1))
```

# CXCL13

```{r, fig.width=5, fig.height=4}
PlotBoxplotsFeatures(
  seuobj@meta.data %>% filter(timepoint == "T0") %>% filter(cellsubtype == "Tfh" | cellstate == "FDC") %>% droplevels,
  seurat = "seuobj",
  features = "CXCL13",
  relative.to = "cellsubtype",
  minDenomFreq = 10,
  plotTitle = NULL,
  exportSampleDF = T
)  %>% 
  group_by(diagSub, cellsubtype, featureVar, .drop = FALSE) %>% 
  mutate(mean = mean(meanVal, na.rm = T)) %>% 
  mutate(se = sd(meanVal, na.rm = T)/sqrt(n())) %>%
  ungroup() %>% 
  mutate(facetName = ifelse(cellsubtype == "Fibroblast", "FDC", as.character(cellsubtype))) %>% 
  mutate(facetName = fct_relevel(facetName, c("Tfh", "FDC"))) %>% 
  ggplot(.,
         aes(x = diagSub, y = meanVal, fill = diagSub)) + 
  geom_bar(stat = "summary", fun = "mean", color = "black", fill = "gray90") +
  geom_point(shape = 21, position = position_jitterdodge(jitter.width = 1.25, seed = thisseed), size = 4, color = "black") +
  geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = mean - se, ymax = mean + se), width=0.3, linewidth=1) +
  facet_wrap(~facetName, scales = "fixed", ncol = 10) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = diagSubColVec) +
  scale_color_manual(values = diagSubColVec) +
  stat_compare_means(comparisons = diagSub.comp, label.y = c(2.7, 3.1, 3.5, 3.9),
                     label = "p.format", vjust = 1.5, size = 5, tip.length = 0.05) +
  # coord_cartesian(ylim = c(-0.1, 0.13)) +
  guides(fill = "none") +
  labs(
    # x = NULL,
    y = "Mean CXCL13 Expression",
    color = NULL,
    fill = NULL,
    title = NULL,
    subtitle = NULL) +
  theme_light() +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(size = 24, face = "bold"),
    plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 18, face = "bold"),
    panel.grid.major.x = element_blank(),
    axis.text.x = element_text(size = 16, face = "bold"),
    axis.text.y = element_text(size = 16, face = "bold"),
    axis.title.x = element_blank(),
    axis.title.y = element_text(size = 16, face = "bold"),
    legend.position = "none",
    legend.text = element_text(size = 12, face = "bold"),
    legend.title = element_text(size = 12, face = "bold"),
    strip.text = element_text(size = 24, face = "bold", color = "black"),
    strip.background = element_rect(fill = "white", colour = "black", linewidth = 1),
  )
```

```{r, fig.width=5.5, fig.height=5.5}
SenderReceiver(
  seuobj@meta.data %>% filter(timepoint == "T0") %>% 
    mutate(cellstate.b = ifelse(cellstate %in% c("GC-like BC", "Prlf. BC"), "TLS-like BC", as.character(cellstate))) %>% 
    mutate(cellstate.b = as.factor(cellstate.b)) %>% 
    droplevels,
  seurat = "seuobj",
  senderCol = "cellstate",
  senderVal = "FDC",
  features.sender = "CXCL13",
  senderProp = FALSE,
  minSenderFreq = 10,
  receiverCol = "cellstate.b",
  receiverVal = c("TLS-like BC"),
  receiverProp = TRUE,
  receiverRelative = "celltype",
  receiverMinDenomFreq = 10,
  facetType = "grid",
  facet_scales = "free_x",
  facet_dir = "v",
  ncol = 4,
  stripSize = 14,
  axisXsize = 16,
  axisYsize = 16,
  regSize = 5,
  groupReg = F,
  fillReg = F,
  exportSampleDF = T
) %>% 
  mutate(lineshow = ifelse(diagSub == "iCD", "hide", "show")) %>% 
  ggplot(aes(x = senderExp, y = prop.receiver, fill = diagSub, color = diagSub)) +
  stat_poly_eq(method = "lm", use_label(c("R2", "P")), size = 8, vstep=0.075, rsquared.conf.level = 0.9999) +
  scale_color_manual(values = diagSubColVec) +
  ggnewscale::new_scale_color() +
  stat_poly_line(method = "lm", aes(color = lineshow), show.legend = FALSE) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("hide" = "white", show = "#3366FF")) +
  geom_point(aes(fill = diagSub), shape = 21, size = 6, alpha = 0.75, color = "black") +
  scale_size_continuous(range = c(2, 7)) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = diagSubColVec) +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = label_percent(), breaks = c(0, 0.25, 0.5, 0.75), limits = c(0, 0.75)) +
  guides(color = "none") +
  labs(
    x = "Mean CXCL13 Exp. (FDC)", 
    y = "TLS-like B Cell Frequency\n(Relative to B cells)", 
    size = "# Cells", 
    fill = NULL,
    subtitle = NULL) +
  theme_light() +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(size = 18, face = "bold"),
    plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 14, face = "bold"),
    axis.text.x = element_text(size = 20, face = "bold", angle = 0, hjust=0.5),
    axis.text.y = element_text(size = 20, face = "bold"),
    axis.title.x = element_text(size = 20, face = "bold"),
    axis.title.y = element_text(size = 20, face = "bold"),
    legend.position = "top",
    legend.text = element_text(size = 20, face = "bold"),
    legend.title = element_text(size = 12, face = "bold"),
    strip.text = element_text(size = 24, face = "bold", color = "black"),
    strip.background = element_rect(fill = "white", colour = "black", linewidth = 1),
  )
```

# IHC

```{r}
tls.df.long %>% 
  mutate(tls_presence = tls > 0, .after = tls) %>% 
  droplevels %>% 
  select(diagSub, tls_presence) %>% 
  table -> tls.contingency

tls.contingency
```

```{r}
chisq.test(tls.contingency)
```

```{r, fig.width=3.5, fig.height=3}
tls.df.long %>% 
  mutate(tls_presence = tls > 0, .after = tls) %>% 
  group_by(diagSub) %>% 
  mutate(tls_numerator = sum(tls_presence), .after = tls_presence) %>% 
  mutate(tls_denominator = n(), .after = tls_numerator) %>% 
  mutate(tls_fraction = paste(tls_numerator, tls_denominator, sep = "/")) %>% 
  mutate(tls_group = tls_numerator/tls_denominator, .after = tls_denominator) %>% 
  distinct(diagSub, .keep_all = T) %>% 
  ungroup %>% 
  mutate(facetName = "Tissue Sections w/ TLS") %>% 
  ggplot(aes(x = diagSub, y = tls_group)) + 
  geom_col(aes(fill = diagSub), color = "black") +
  geom_text(aes(label = tls_fraction), nudge_y = 0.05, size = 4.55, fontface = "bold") +
  scale_fill_manual(values = diagSubColVec) +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = percent, limits = c(0, 1)) +
  guides(fill = "none") +
  facet_grid(~facetName) +
  labs(
    y = "% of Biopsies with TLS Identified",
    color = NULL,
    fill = NULL,
    title = NULL,
    subtitle = NULL) +
  theme_light() +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(size = 24, face = "bold"),
    plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 18, face = "bold"),
    panel.grid.major.x = element_blank(),
    axis.text.x = element_text(size = 16, face = "bold"),
    axis.text.y = element_text(size = 12, face = "bold"),
    axis.title.x = element_blank(),
    axis.title.y = element_text(size = 12, face = "bold"),
    legend.position = "none",
    legend.text = element_text(size = 12, face = "bold"),
    legend.title = element_text(size = 12, face = "bold"),
    strip.text = element_text(size = 14, face = "bold", color = "black"),
    strip.background = element_rect(fill = "white", colour = "black", linewidth = 1),
  ) +
  annotate("text", x = 2.5, y = 1, label = "p = 0.697", size = 5)
```

```{r, fig.width=3.5, fig.height=3}
p28.df.long %>% 
  filter(marker == "CD20+") %>% 
  filter(area == "TLS") %>% 
  filter(!is.na(density)) %>% 
  group_by(diagSub) %>% 
  mutate(mean = mean(density, na.rm = T)) %>% 
  mutate(se = sd(density, na.rm = T)/sqrt(n())) %>%
  ungroup %>% 
  mutate(facetName = "CD20+ in TLS") %>% 
  ggplot(aes(x = diagSub, y = density)) +
  geom_dotplot(binaxis = "y", stackdir = "center", stackratio = 0.75, dotsize=2.50, aes(fill = diagSub)) +
  geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = mean - se, ymax = mean + se), width=0.3, linewidth=1) +
  stat_summary(fun = "mean", geom = "crossbar", width = 0.6, linewidth = 0.6,
               color = "black") +
  scale_fill_manual(values = diagSubColVec) +
  stat_compare_means(comparisons = diagSub.comp,
                     label = "p.format", vjust = 1.2, size = 4.5, tip.length = 0.05) +
  facet_wrap(~facetName) +
  guides(fill = "none") +
  labs(
    y = "CD20+ Count/mm2 (TLS)",
    color = NULL,
    fill = NULL,
    title = NULL,
    subtitle = NULL) +
  theme_light() +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(size = 24, face = "bold"),
    plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 18, face = "bold"),
    panel.grid.major.x = element_blank(),
    axis.text.x = element_text(size = 16, face = "bold"),
    axis.text.y = element_text(size = 16, face = "bold"),
    axis.title.x = element_blank(),
    axis.title.y = element_text(size = 16, face = "bold"),

    legend.title = element_text(size = 12, face = "bold"),
    strip.text = element_text(size = 14, face = "bold", color = "black"),
```
